title: BNCI 2015-013 Error-Related Potentials dataset
description: EEG dataset of error-related potentials (ErrPs) recorded from six participants while they monitored a cursor moving autonomously toward a target, with 20% or 40% error probability. Participants had no control over the cursor, showing that error correlates can be observed and decoded when monitoring an external agent. Recordings were made with 64 channels at 512 Hz across 20 sessions per subject, and the data support single-trial error detection for brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: 64-channel EEG was recorded with a Biosemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz. Participants sat in front of a screen and watched a cursor (green square) move toward a left or right target without controlling it. Each session had 10 blocks of about 180 s, and the cursor moved with 20% or 40% error probability. Events were labelled Target and NonTarget, and a Gaussian classifier was applied to event-related potentials in the 1-10 Hz band.
